veranderings.rede: Commas around the example keep a Grade 5 reader from parsing "'n bergrug skei" as the subject and verb, and make the main clause easier to follow.

veranderings.voor: Reën aan die een kant van so
veranderings.na: Reënwater aan die een kant van so
veranderings.rede: It is the rainwater that runs off to a river, not the rain itself; this also matches "reënwater" earlier in the block.

vlae.teks: Aan die einde van sy pad kom 'n rivier by sy mond.
vlae.rede: Read alone this says every river reaches a mouth, while the next two sentences say only most do and some end in a marsh or dry pan; a writer may want to soften it, which is a content decision, not a language one.
